subject: Taxes
title: Airdrops and Free Crypto Income
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Airdrops and Free Crypto Income.

hook.text: In 2020, Uniswap airdropped 400 UNI tokens to every past user.

buildup.text: Airdrops send free tokens to wallet holders as marketing or rewards.

discovery.text: The IRS ruled in 2019 that airdrops are ordinary income at fair market value when received.

twist.text: Some airdrops are worthless by the time you notice them.

climax.text: Airdrops highlight crypto tax's core absurdity: you can be taxed on income you never requested and can't refuse.

punchline.text: Free tokens, mandatory taxes. Airdrops prove crypto tax has no opt-out.

quiz.question: How are crypto airdrops taxed according to the IRS?
options: As ordinary income at fair market value when received
